{{Quote|You saw what the ''Iron Fist'' did on Selaggis. It turned the whole colony into rubble. I kept following it for months, and everywhere we went it was the same: star stations obliterated, shipyards ruined. Just one Super Star Destroyer with a murderer at the helm.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] led an '''attack''' on [[Selcaron]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Selaggis VI]],<ref name="SC" /> which was the location of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Unidentified colony (Selcaron)|colony]].<ref name="DoaE1" /> Zsinj used his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], to obliterate the colony.<ref name="SC" />
